technology.alt: Detail of copper-coloured textile and pillow, technology mood illustration
technology.caption: COPPER FIBRES · WEAVING · MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY
technology.title: What makes copper-fibre textile special?
technology.intro: Copper is an electrically conductive metal. When copper-containing fibres are woven or otherwise incorporated into a textile, the material can gain technical properties that differ from conventional fabrics. Their extent depends on the copper content, the structure of the weave and the design of the finished product.

facts.title: Copper-containing fibres
facts.text: The conductive fibres are part of the fabric structure. The exact copper content and material composition must be confirmed by the manufacturer's data sheet.

facts.title: Electromagnetic shielding
facts.text: With a suitable design, a conductive textile can attenuate electromagnetic signals at certain frequencies. The degree of shielding can be measured in a laboratory, frequency by frequency. We currently do not publish any verified measurement values for CUPRÉ Original.

facts.title: Copper and microorganisms
facts.text: The antimicrobial properties of certain copper surfaces have been studied. This alone does not prove that this particular sheet is antibacterial, prevents infection or provides any health benefit.

facts.title: Sleep and well-being
facts.text: We do not have adequate evidence that this particular copper sheet improves sleep quality or protects against the health effects of environmental radiation. CUPRÉ presents a distinctive textile technology and the experience of resting at home.

technology.note: Technical claims will be refined once the product-specific documentation from Lorix / the material manufacturer has been received. This description is for information only and is not medical advice.

care.alt: Deep green and copper bedroom with a copper-coloured sheet
title: Harmony lies
in the details.
paragraphs: We believe in a thoughtfully designed home, in special materials and in the value of time set aside for rest.

The copper sheet is placed on the lying surface so that you lie on it – it is not pulled over you like a blanket. The exact layering, instructions for use and care will be finalised based on the manufacturer's documentation.
